skill.name: skywork-excel
skill.description: Create and refine Excel workbooks, charts, formulas, dashboards, and HTML reports through the Skywork Excel backend service.
skill.summary: Generate Excel and report outputs from natural language requests and uploaded data files.
skill.author: SkyworkAI

security_audit.summary: The audit confirmed real risks around external Skywork API use, user-file upload, token caching in ~/.skywork_token, local log/output writes, and one Windows shell invocation. Most SKILL.md backtick findings are markdown false positives, not executable Ruby or shell code. Instruction-level issues remain because the skill tells agents to upload files to a backend and ignore backend log errors.

remediation.issue: User files are uploaded to an external Skywork backend.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user consent before upload and document data handling, retention, and deletion guarantees.
Store tokens with 0600 permissions or use the platform credential store, and provide a clear logout or cache removal command.

remediation.issue: Windows browser launch uses subprocess with shell=True.
remediation.suggestion: Replace shell=True with a safer browser-opening API such as webbrowser.open or os.startfile for Windows.

remediation.issue: Progress logs are written to /tmp or caller-supplied paths.
remediation.suggestion: Use secure temporary-file creation, restrict permissions, and avoid writing prompts, tokens, or sensitive filenames to logs.

remediation.issue: Skill instructions tell agents to ignore log errors.
remediation.suggestion: Remove no-exceptions language and require reporting security, authentication, upload, and download failures to the user.

semantic_findings.title: External Upload of User Files to Skywork Backend
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs agents not to inspect user files locally and to upload Excel, PDF, CSV, and image files to the Skywork backend. content.value_statement: Spreadsheet work often needs formulas, charts, file conversion, and careful formatting. This skill sends the task to Skywork Excel Agent to produce Excel files or HTML reports.
actual_capabilities: Sends natural language spreadsheet tasks to the Skywork Excel Agent backend.
Uploads Excel, CSV, PDF, and image files for backend processing.
Streams task progress and clarification events from a server-sent events endpoint.
Downloads generated Excel, CSV, HTML, PDF, image, and ZIP outputs.
Supports iterative refinement by reusing session identifiers.
Uses Skywork authentication through an environment token, cached token, or browser login.
limitations: Requires a valid Skywork account token and reachable Skywork backend services.
Uploads prompts and files to an external service, so sensitive data needs prior approval.
Complex report jobs can take several minutes and may require progress polling.
Output quality depends on the backend agent and the clarity of the user request.

use_cases.title: Build monthly business reports
use_cases.description: Create formatted workbooks with summaries, charts, and downloadable report files from sales or operations data.

use_cases.title: Analyze uploaded spreadsheets
use_cases.description: Upload Excel or CSV files, request trends or summaries, and receive structured outputs for review.

use_cases.title: Convert documents into tables
use_cases.description: Send PDFs or images to the backend and request extracted tables or cleaned spreadsheet outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excel workbook for monthly expenses with date, category, amount, notes, totals, and basic formatting.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a data file
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the uploaded sales spreadsheet. Summarize revenue by product, identify top customers, and add clear charts.

prompt_templates.title: Generate an executive report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an HTML and Excel report from the uploaded quarterly data with trends, risks, recommendations, and supporting charts.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a prior output
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the previous session, add a regional breakdown sheet, improve chart labels, and update the summary for executives.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly expense tracker with categories and totals.
output_examples.output: A formatted Excel workbook with entry columns, category totals, summary formulas, and a clean layout.

output_examples.input: Analyze uploaded sales data and show the top products.
output_examples.output: A workbook or HTML report with revenue summaries, ranked products, visual charts, and downloadable result links.

output_examples.input: Turn this PDF table into an editable spreadsheet.
output_examples.output: An extracted table in Excel format with cleaned columns, normalized values, and a downloadable file path.

best_practices: Confirm that files are approved for upload before using the backend service.
Give exact columns, chart types, output format, and audience requirements in the request.
Reuse the printed session identifier when asking for changes to a previous output.
anti_patterns: Do not upload confidential files without user approval and data handling review.
Do not treat generated formulas, charts, or extracted data as verified without checking them.
Do not start duplicate long-running jobs when progress logs show that a task is still active.

faq.question: Does this skill work without a Skywork account?
faq.answer: No. The scripts require a valid Skywork token or an interactive Skywork login flow.

faq.question: Can it process existing files?
faq.answer: Yes. The client uploads supported local files and passes backend file identifiers to the Skywork agent.

faq.question: Where are results delivered?
faq.answer: The backend returns output metadata, local download paths, and OSS links when available.

faq.question: Can it continue a previous task?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the returned session identifier for follow-up changes and iterative refinement.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive data?
faq.answer: Use caution. The skill uploads prompts and files to an external Skywork service for processing.

faq.question: What outputs can it create?
faq.answer: It can produce Excel workbooks, CSV files, HTML reports, PDFs, images, and ZIP archives when the backend supports them.
